title: Run list refusal
description: The body of a refusal of GET /v1/runs, the run list (runs.schema.json), application/json. error is the refusal code. 400 invalid_request: a query parameter breaks a rule of runs.schema.json, and parameter is the name of that parameter; when more than one parameter breaks a rule, parameter is the name of one of them. Qory Apiary verifies the request before it reads the query, as it verifies a request for the run diagnostics. A request that fails that check is refused with this body and no parameter: 401 unauthorized, unsigned, for a key that is not enrolled on the instance, has been revoked or is not a diagnostics key, and for each cause that https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/refusal.schema.json lists for 401, a replayed signature among them; 400 bad_request for a signing header sent twice, or an instance id that is absent or outside its form; 400 unsupported_contract_version for a contract version that Qory Apiary does not serve. Version 1 changes only by adding members, as for the run diagnostics, so a reader ignores a member this schema does not define.

error.description: The refusal code, such as invalid_request.

parameter.description: The name of the query parameter that breaks a rule, after percent-decoding. It is present also for a name that is not one of the parameters of the run list. Each control character, U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F, is replaced with U+FFFD. A name over 64 characters is cut to its first 64. The value is empty for a parameter with an empty name. Present exactly when error is invalid_request.
